# Poly Haven assets — CC0

Eight props downloaded from https://polyhaven.com via its public API on
2026-07-28. Poly Haven publishes everything under **CC0 1.0** (public domain
dedication): no attribution required, commercial use permitted, no conditions.
Attribution is recorded here anyway because knowing where a file came from is
worth more than the licence requires.

| asset | source page |

| cardboard_box_01 | https://polyhaven.com/a/cardboard_box_01 |
| covered_car | https://polyhaven.com/a/covered_car |
| caged_hanging_light | https://polyhaven.com/a/caged_hanging_light |

glTF, 1k textures — chosen over 2k/4k because these are set dressing seen at
walking distance, and the whole set at 1k costs 17 MB.
